title: "What If Today Was the Last Day Before Jesus Returns?" 🔥
paragraphs:
"What If Today Was the Last Day Before Jesus Returns?" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Imagine this: It’s midnight. You’re lying in bed, scrolling through your phone.

Suddenly, the sky cracks open with a deafening sound.
A trumpet blast shakes the earth.
You run outside, and you see Him—Jesus Christ—returning in glory.
It’s too late to repent. Too late to pray. Too late to choose.
What if today was the last day before Jesus returns? Would you be ready?
📖 “So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect Him.” (Matthew 24:44)

🔥 The Bible Warns Us: Jesus Is Coming Unexpectedly
Many people live as if Jesus is delaying His return.
They think, "I have time to get right with God later."
But Jesus said otherwise.
📖 “For you yourselves know very well that the day of the Lord will come just like a thief in the night.” (1 Thessalonians 5:2)
🚨 A thief doesn’t announce when he’s coming. He comes suddenly. Unexpectedly.

🔥 If Jesus Returned Tonight, What Would He Find?
Jesus Himself asked a haunting question:
📖 “When the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on the earth?” (Luke 18:8)
What will He find when He returns?

✅ A world full of distractions.
✅ Churches full of people, but hearts far from God.
✅ Many who say they love Jesus but deny Him with their lives.
💡 The scariest thing? Many will think they are saved… but Jesus will reject them.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)
🚨 Don’t just assume you’re ready. MAKE SURE.

🔥 3 Questions to Ask Yourself Right Now
If Jesus comes tonight, can you answer these questions with confidence?
1️⃣ Have I truly placed my faith in Jesus Christ alone for salvation?

Not church attendance. Not good works. Only Jesus.
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)
2️⃣ Am I living in obedience to Christ?

True salvation produces a changed life.
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)
3️⃣ Have I shared the Gospel with those around me?

If you KNEW Jesus was coming tomorrow, would you finally tell your friends and family?
📖 “Go and make disciples of all nations.” (Matthew 28:19)
🔥 What Will Happen When Jesus Returns?
The Bible tells us exactly what will happen on that day.

✅ The dead in Christ will rise first.
📖 “For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven… and the dead in Christ will rise first.” (1 Thessalonians 4:16)

✅ Believers will be caught up to meet Him.
📖 “Then we who are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air.” (1 Thessalonians 4:17)

✅ Unbelievers will face judgment.
📖 “He will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.” (Matthew 25:32)
🚨 For believers, this is a glorious day. For unbelievers, it’s a day of terror.

🔥 How to Be 100% Ready for Jesus’ Return
Jesus isn’t looking for perfect people—He’s looking for prepared people.
Are you ready? Here’s how you can be sure:
✅ 1. Repent and Believe in Jesus Christ.

Turn away from sin and trust in Jesus alone for salvation.
📖 “Unless you repent, you will all perish.” (Luke 13:3)
✅ 2. Live Every Day for Jesus.

Follow Him, not the world.
📖 “Be doers of the Word, not just hearers.” (James 1:22)
✅ 3. Share the Gospel Boldly.

If Jesus is coming soon, why stay silent?
📖 “How can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard?” (Romans 10:14)
📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to live as if Jesus is returning soon. I place my faith in Christ alone for salvation. I will not be distracted, I will not be lukewarm—I will be ready."

🔥 THE “BE READY” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Make sure YOU are right with God.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to be ready.

🌌 WHAT IF THIS REALLY IS THE LAST DAY? 🌌
📖 “Behold, I am coming soon!” (Revelation 22:12)

👉 Don’t wait until it’s too late. Get right with God TODAY.
👉 Jesus is coming—be ready.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I know You are coming soon, and I don’t want to be caught unprepared. I repent of my sins and place my full trust in Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior. Help me live each day for You, and give me boldness to share Your truth with others. Thank You for Your grace and mercy.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
